free_tier.stated: No free tier: Standard Object Storage SWIFT is billed from the first GB at USD 0.000017 per GB-hour (about USD 0.01241 per GB-month), with incoming and outgoing public traffic free
free_tier.notes: billed per GiB-hour; the monthly figure is the hourly price x 730 hours

per_object_cap.stated: 5368709122 bytes (5 GB) for a normal object; a larger object is uploaded in segments of up to that size
per_object_cap.notes: a segmented large object has no total size stated on the page read

retention.stated: unlimited volume and time: objects are kept until deleted, and no minimum storage duration is stated
retention.notes: the Swift price table has no minimum storage column

egress.terms: Internal traffic, incoming public traffic and outgoing public traffic are all free

record.interface_detail: OpenStack Swift API; a partial S3-compatible API on the Standard class
record.tooling: python-swiftclient, rclone (Swift backend), Cyberduck, any Swift or S3 client
record.chaining: a Swift container can serve static content over HTTP; the S3-compatible classes are the recommended path for new data

limits.value: 5368709122 bytes (5 GB) per normal object; larger objects use segments

record.limits_note: Legacy class: the Swift storage classes no longer benefit from further developments; the S3-compatible classes are recommended for new applications; billing granularity is 1 GB
record.binding_note: none: storage has no stated cap, and a normal object is limited to 5 GB, with larger objects stored as segments

identity_cost.detail: an email address validated by a one-time code, the country of tax residence, and a valid payment method on the account before the first Public Cloud project

record.reliability_note: triple replication of the data within one datacentre; no availability SLA figure is stated on the pages read
record.confidence_note: documented: the international price list, the storage classes pages, the endpoints page and the technical limits page were read and quoted on 2026-11-03; a read timed from a bucket would make it measured

evidence.quote: | Standard Object Storage SWIFT | Free | Free | Free | $0.000017 | ~$0.01241 |
evidence.proved: Standard Object Storage SWIFT costs USD 0.000017 per GB-hour, about USD 0.01241 per GB-month, with internal, incoming and outgoing traffic free

evidence.quote: For optimal readability, the price is displayed as GB/month – but since there are 730 hours in an average month, the invoicing granularity is GB/hour.
evidence.proved: Swift Object Storage is invoiced per GB-hour and the monthly figure assumes 730 hours

evidence.quote: The Standard storage class (Swift) offers a data storage service with no particular need for performance, within a resilient architecture by triple replication of data within the same datacentre.
evidence.proved: Swift Standard keeps three replicas of the data in one datacentre

evidence.quote: The solution is accessible via a Swift API and an Amazon S3-compatible API (less compatible than the new Object Storage solutions (Standard/High Performance)).
evidence.proved: Swift Standard is reached through the Swift API and a partial S3-compatible API

evidence.quote: The Swift storage classes are from older generations and no longer benefit from further developments.
evidence.proved: the Swift classes are legacy and receive no further development

evidence.quote: | SWIFT Object Storage | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |  |  | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |  |
evidence.proved: Swift Object Storage is offered in Strasbourg, Gravelines, Roubaix, London, Frankfurt and Warsaw and not in the 3-AZ regions

evidence.quote: The largest normal object that can be saved in the cluster. This is also the limit on the size of each segment of a large object when using the large object manifest media.
evidence.proved: the Swift cluster limits a normal object to 5 GB and uses segments for larger ones

evidence.quote: ### max_file_size = 5368709122 (5Gb)
evidence.proved: the Swift maximum normal object is 5368709122 bytes

evidence.quote: You need to add a valid payment method to your OVHcloud customer account before starting the free trial, which will be used after your free trial ends, if you want to keep running the project you have launched.
evidence.proved: a valid payment method is required on the account before the first Public Cloud project

evidence.quote: After you submit this form, a one-time code will be sent to the email address you entered.
evidence.proved: account creation validates the email address with a one-time code

record.price_per_tb_month: USD 12.41 per TB per month (USD 0.01241 per GB-month x 1000 GB per TB); one rate at every volume
record.notes: billed per GB-hour with a 1 GB granularity; Swift containers are offered in Strasbourg, Gravelines, Roubaix, London, Frankfurt and Warsaw
